signals_info.description: Time headway to the selected lead vehicle.

time_info.description: Bounded headway-satisfaction window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 5 seconds, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall be greater than 2 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 5 秒内，与前车的时间车头时距应至少有一个时刻大于 2 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 5-second window including now, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall be greater than 2 seconds at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 5 秒窗口内，与前车的时间车头时距应至少有一个时刻大于 2 秒。
